title: Minimalist header — wallpaper through every control

steps.headline: Every header control now lets the wallpaper show through.
steps.changed: Removed the colour and gradient from individual buttons, the session switcher backing and the Chat/Terminal selection. Each retains a local blur and soft shadow; the full-width veil stays off.
steps.notice: The count badge and active session name keep their own colours so they remain legible. This is the header only; message box and chips are unchanged.
